## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in this reference implementation.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run python scripts/check.py`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has deterministic regression coverage where practical.
- [ ] Live-provider tests were run only when the change requires them.

## Security and documentation

- [ ] Trust boundaries, URL/network authority, provenance, and resource limits are unchanged or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] User-facing documentation was updated when behavior or commands changed.
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated for durable architectural decisions.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated caches, or local environment files are included.
